cast

Episodes

1. Pilot

Seventeen-year-old Rue returns home from rehab with no plans to stay clean.

2. Stuntin' Like My Daddy

On the first day of school, Rue has a new friend, Jules, but struggles to put the past behind her.

3. Made You Look

Kat starts camming. Jules falls for a boy online. Rue is confronted at NA, and Cassie visits McKay at college.

4. Shook Ones Pt. II

Rue, trying to get clean for Jules, chaperones Gia at the carnival. Jules encounters Cal with his family.

5. '03 Bonnie and Clyde

Maddy and Nate must deal with a police investigation. Rue and Jules each reflect on their relationship.

6. The Next Episode

On Halloween, Rue worries about her reliance on Jules when she starts acting strange; McKay questions his future; Nate comes up with a plan.

7. The Trials and Tribulations of Trying to Pee While Depressed

Rue gets depressed and watches 22 straight episodes of a British reality show.​ Jules visits an old friend.

8. And Salt the Earth Behind You

It's the winter formal at East Highland.

a pivotal season, captured on film

Season 3 of Euphoria was filmed on new Kodak motion picture film stock in 35mm and 65mm. Creator Sam Levinson and cinematographer Marcell Rév collaborated closely with Kodak to commercialize the new stock in each format. Season 3 is also the first narrative television series to shoot a significant volume of 65mm film, providing an expanded image on-screen that mirrors the characters’ journeys out of high school and into the wider, wilder world.

About This Series

Zendaya stars in this Emmy®-winning drama series that follows a group of friends as they navigate a minefield of drugs, sex, identity, trauma, social media, love, and friendship in today's increasingly unstable world.

Starring

Zendaya, Sydney Sweeney, Jacob Elordi, Alexa Demie, Hunter Schafer, Maude Apatow, Colman Domingo, Eric Dane, Martha Kelly, Chloe Cherry, Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje, Toby Wallace
